review:
A cheerful beer keg and his woodland friends on a 5x4 grid with up to 100,000 ways, mixing Hacksaw's Stackways with a book-style bonus.

Stackways symbols can fill a reel with one symbol – normal ones stack up to four high, revealing ones fill a full reel of 10 – but only when that makes a win. The Book of Stackways bonus starts with 10 free spins and picks two special symbols that stack up to 10 rows on three or more reels. Rated 3/5, 10,000x max (in the base game too), top RTP 96.17%.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 88.26% RTP
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
